name: MyMemeCards
summary:
MyMemeCards is a free-to-play online collectible card game in which the cards depict internet memes. Players obtain cards by opening packs, with each card belonging to a rarity tier and a seasonal edition. Collections can be completed over time, and cards can be traded between players or sold at auction.

The game includes several mini-games which reward players with MemeCoins, the in-game currency used to bid on and sell cards on the market. New cards are partly decided by the community through a system called Memocracy, in which players propose memes and vote on which ones are added to the game. MyMemeCards is played in a web browser on desktop and mobile devices.
